about.en: IDOL is the token of MEET48, a Web3 entertainment platform built around the idol fan economy with AI-generated content, virtual idols and fan voting, run with the Chinese idol group SNH48 as a strategic partner. IDOL (MEET48 Token) is a BNB Smart Chain BEP-20 token at 0x3b4de3c7855c03bb9f50ea252cd2c9fa1125ab07.
